title: Industrial Engineering and Operations Research and Business BS
notes:
M.E.T. General Guidelines
General Guidelines
- A minimum of 38 upper division business units is required.
- Students must complete the degree program in eight semesters, not including Summer Session.
- Students must complete ALL of their business prerequisite courses (including R&C) by the spring semester of their sophomore (2nd) year. Required prerequisite courses are: UGBA 10X; ECON 1 or ECON 2; Math 51 & Math 52 , or Math 53 or Math 54; Reading & Composition Parts A & B; and, depending on their major track, students may choose one of the following statistics courses or combinations:
- EECS 126
- ENGIN 178 (recommended for ME)
- INDENG 172 (required for IEOR)
- STAT 20
- STAT 21/STAT W21
- STAT C131A
- STAT 134 (recommended for BioE)
- STAT/DATA C140
- DATA C8, plus:
- UGBA 88, or
- CIV ENG 93, or
- DATA 89, or
- DATA C88S/STAT C88S
- DATA C100, plus:
- UGBA 88, or
- CIV ENG 93, or
- DATA 89, or
- DATA C88S/STAT 88S
- All Haas business courses must be taken for a letter grade, including core substitutions, with the exception of UGBA 194, UGBA 198 and UGBA 199 (only offered Pass/No Pass).
- Students who receive a grade of D+ or lower in a core UGBA course must repeat the course until they achieve a grade of C- or better.
- All technical courses that can be used to fulfill a requirement must be taken for a letter grade.
- Two M.E.T. Special Topics courses are required. One during the first year, first semester and another during the third year, first semester. M.E.T. Special Topics courses will count as upper division business elective units. A passing grade of C- or better is required.
- Students in this program must adhere to all policies and procedures of the College of Engineering and the Haas School of Business.
- Students must complete the College Requirements and the Program Major Requirements.

AND PHYSICS 5BL - Introduction to Experimental Physics I
- Physics 7A may be fulfilled with exam credit. Students may choose to take the Physics 7 series or the Physics 5 series. … (see the catalog for the rest)

requirements.title: Core
requirements.notes:
- STAT 134, STAT C140/DATA C140 or IND ENG 172 will be accepted for the Business Administration statistics requirement for students in the M.E.T. Program. The statistics requirement for Business Administration must be completed by the spring semester of sophomore year. IND ENG 172 is an alternative course for STAT 134 or STAT C140/DATA C140. In semesters when IND ENG 172 is offered, we recommend students take IND ENG 172. Students will receive credit for only one of these courses.
- IND ENG 171 is REQUIRED for M.E.T. students and will be used to fulfill the UGBA 105 requirement for the Business major and will count as 3 units of upper division UGBA coursework.

requirements.title: Ethics
requirements.notes:
- DATA C104/HISTORY C184D should be taken to fulfill the IEOR Ethics Requirement and the M.E.T. Historical Studies breadth requirement.
- UGBA courses will not fulfill the IEOR Ethics Requirement.
- Students who take IND ENG 151 and IND ENG 150, or IND ENG 151 and IND ENG 153, will not receive credit for UGBA 141.
